data.long_meaning: Awanish is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'awanish,' which means 'radiant' or 'bright.' This name is often used to describe someone who shines or stands out in a crowd. The name Awanish carries the meaning “Radiant, Bright, Shining” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Awanish usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, bright, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
